mode: Behavioral scenarios; expected outcomes are rubrics, not executed MCP results

evals.prompt: Upload a PDF and make AI use it immediately.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not equate upload with readiness; it verifies processing/indexing/publication before testing retrieval/grounding.

evals.prompt: A scanned PDF is active but AI never cites its facts.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks extraction/OCR/chunks/index health and trace retrieval before changing prompt text.

evals.prompt: Two versions of a policy file are active with conflicting refund terms.
evals.expected_output: The skill flags a fact/version conflict, preserves provenance, and does not let the AI pick silently.

evals.prompt: A filename says '2026 Price List' so use those prices in answers.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not infer contents from filename; it requires authorized content evidence and successful ingestion.
The skill reads the existing document/version processing state before any retry and avoids duplicate source versions.
